Name: NPC Map Locations - Extra Config
Author: trashcan9
Description:
This mod adds additional options for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/239]NPC Map Locations[/url] mod.

[size=5]Features[/size]
[list]
[*]Hide NPCs that have never been met.
[*]Hide NPCs based on heart level.
[*]Hide NPCs based on whether talked to today.
[/list]

[size=5]Recommended Mods[/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16233]Tidy Social[/url]: This mod pairs well with Tidy Social which cleans up the Social Page and Birthday Calendar similarly based on whether an NPC is unmet or based on hearts.
[/list]

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Install the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/239]NPC Map Locations[/url] mod.
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.5.6 on Linux/macOS/Windows.
[*]Works in single player, multiplayer, and split-screen mode. If there are issues, please report them.
[/list]

[size=5]Configuration[/size]
[list]
[*]Configuration options allow you to modify setting. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] to adjust config in game.
[/list]

[size=5]Known Issues[/size]
[list]
[*]None currently.
[/list]
